findings.text: Line 4 prices $16,570.00 of sub-tier stair pan, rail and finish work with no quote anywhere in the package or the Change Event attachment set; the cover sheet itself marks the line "Revising with subs / Pending Revision". [CE #391](https://app.procore.com/2295239/project/change_events/events)

Line 6 applies a 5.00% sub-tier fee of $828.50 to that unquoted cost, so the fee is unsupported for the same reason the base line is. [CE #391](https://app.procore.com/2295239/project/change_events/events)

Neither the 15.00% own-cost fee nor the 5.00% sub-tier fee, $3,519.20 combined, has a retrievable contractual basis: no rate exhibit or markup schedule is attached to the commitment, and matching precedent CORs is corroboration rather than a contractual basis. [SC-1040-004](https://app.procore.com/2295239/project/commitments/work_order_contracts/13021040)

This scope was subsequently executed as Commitment CO #001 at $28,341.00, $9,686.00 below the COR as submitted; confirm with BASE Builders that the executed value supersedes this submission before acting on it.
